timeline.summary: SWAN CORP LIMITED’s shareholders approved via remote e-voting: Ms. Bhagwati Sharma (DIN: 09632127) and Mr. Ashish Chhabria (DIN: 11564611) as Non-Executive Independent Directors on 19-May-2026.
Swan Corp Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Saptarshi Ganguly, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.15 per equity share (15%) for FY 2025-26 on May 29, 2026.
